core.headline: Ex-local-authority mid-terrace house, Lordswood, Chatham, Kent
core.listing:
An ex-local-authority mid-terrace house with three bedrooms in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham, at a guide price of £285,000. The property is freehold. There is no onward chain.

The ground floor has a lounge measuring 4.62m x 3.48m (15'2" x 11'5"). The kitchen/diner measures 5.45m x 2.90m (17'11" x 9'6"). A lean-to utility is accessed from the kitchen.

The first floor has three bedrooms. Bedroom 1 measures 3.80m x 3.10m (12'6" x 10'2"). Bedroom 2 measures 3.30m x 2.95m (10'10" x 9'8"). Bedroom 3 measures 2.40m x 2.05m (7'10" x 6'9"). There is one bathroom.

The rear garden measures approx. 9m (30ft). It has a gate to a shared rear path. Parking is on-street and no permit is required.

Gas central heating is installed. The Worcester boiler was fitted in 2019. Construction is standard – brick under a concrete tiled roof. Electricity, water and sewerage are mains. Water is metered. Broadband is FTTC.

Guide Price £285,000. Tenure: Freehold. Council Tax: Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating: C. There is a pedestrian right of way along the shared rear path. There is a damp mark on the bathroom ceiling from a cracked roof tile, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated. The seller is unaware of planning or building regulations approval for the lean-to utility.
